source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.9.1 with Table 9.7, printed pages 206 and 208.

blocks.text: Titration mein indicator istemal karne ke do aam usool yeh hain ke titration ke aakhir mein pH indicator ke neutral point ke qareeb ho, aur indicator titration ke equivalence point ke qareeb tez rang ki tabdeeli dikhaye. Har pH indicator pH ki ek muqarrar range mein rang badalta hai, jise indicator range kehte hain; indicator taqreeban 2 pH units ki range mein rang badalta hai.

blocks.caption: Aam indicators ki pH ranges (Table 9.7, rang print ke mutabiq)
rows: strong acid-strong base; strong acid-weak base
weak acid-strong base (aur strong acid-strong base)

blocks.prompt: Weak acid-strong base titration ke liye indicator tajweez karein, aur wazahat karein ke weak acid-weak base titration ke liye koi indicator achha kaam kyun nahi karta (Quick Check 9.6c, d).
blocks.explanation: Weak acid strong base ke saath: equivalence point basic hai kyunke salt ka anion hydrolyse hota hai, to phenolphthalein (8.2 se 10.0) munasib hai. Weak acid weak base ke saath: equivalence point ke aas paas pH sirf aahista badalta hai, koi tez chhalang nahi, to koi indicator tez tabdeeli nahi deta; aisi titrations volumetric analysis mein istemal nahi hotin.

items: Aisa indicator chunein jis ki rang ki tabdeeli (taqreeban 2 pH units chauri) equivalence point ke qareeb aur tez ho: methyl orange 3.2 se 4.5, phenolphthalein 8.2 se 10.0 (Table 9.7).
